smooth_contours — 2D contour op

• Data kinds: contour → contour

• Call: fullseye.apply(img, "smooth_contours", a=0.5, b=0.5) (the 2-D model is one image plus two scalar knobs a,b∈[0,1])

• HALCON equivalent: smooth_contours_xld (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

Usage

Smooths XLD contours using a moving average. Equivalent to HALCON's `smooth_contours_xld` (Smooth an XLD contour.).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

`a が平滑化窓の半幅を 1〜4（窓長 2w+1 = 3,5,7,9）に振る。b は未使用。各輪郭の (row, col) 列を独立に等重み移動平均（np.convolve の "same"` モード）で均す。点数が窓長の 2 倍以下の短い輪郭はそのまま素通しする（平滑化されない）。
